English: Rotavirus incidence remains relatively high in low-income countries (LICs) compared to high-income countries (HICs) after vaccine introduction.
Luganda: Ekizibu kya rotavirus kikyali kinene mu mawanga agakyakula (LIC) bw’ogeraageranya n’amawanga agaakula (HICs) okugema bwe kwamala okujja.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ṣì pọ̀ ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó ń powó kékeré (LICs) yàtọ̀ sí ti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí wọ́n ń powó púpọ̀ (HICs) lẹ́yìn àfihàn àjẹsára.
Zulu: Izehlakalo ze-Rotavirus zihlala ziphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi (LICs) uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe anemali engenayo ephezulu (HICs) ngemva kokwethulwa komgomo.
Hausa: Rikicin cutar zawon yara ya kasance mai girma a cikin ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfi (LICs) idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashe masu wadata (HICs) bayan gabatarwar rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Seabe seo rotavirus se nago le sona se godingwana ka dinageng tše di hwetšago letseno le lennyane (di-LIC) ge go bapetšwa le ka dinageng tše di hwetšago letseno la godimo (di-HIC) morago ga go hlagišwa ga moento.
Amharic: ክትባት ከተጀመረ በኋላ የሮታ ቫይረስ ክስተት ከፍተኛ ገቢ ካላቸው ሃገሮች (ከ.ገ.ሃ) ይልቅ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው ሃገሮች (ዝ.ገ.ሃ) በአንጸራዊ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን ቀጥሏል፡፡

English: Ghana introduced monovalent rotavirus vaccine in April 2012 and despite the high coverage, vaccine performance has been modest compared to developed countries.
Luganda: Gahana yatandika okukozesa eddagala erigema erya monovalent rotavirus vaccine mu Gwokuna 2012, kyokka wadde nga likozeseddwa mu bitundu ebiwerako, okukola kw’eddgala eryo erigema kukyali kusaamusaamu bw’ogeraageranya n’amawanga agaakula edda.
Yoruba: Ghana ṣàfihàn àjẹsára oní fálẹ́nsì kan tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ fún fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru gbuuru ní oṣù Igbe ọdún 2012 pẹ̀lú bí ó tún ṣe gbilẹ̀ tó, wọ́n ṣe àfiwéra bí àjẹsára náà ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ sí pẹ̀lú bí ó ṣe ń ṣiṣé sí ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìdàgbàsókè ti bá.
Zulu: I-Ghana yethula umuthi wokugomela i-monovalent rotavirus ngo-Ephreli 2012 futhi naphezu kokutholakala okuphezulu, ukusebenza komjovo bekuthobekile uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe athuthukile.
Hausa: Ƙasar Ghana ta ɓullo da allurar rigakafin cutar zawon yara a watan Afrilun shekarar 2012 kuma duk da yawan yaɗuwar cutar, aikin rigakafin ya yi kaɗan idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashen da suka ci gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ghana e tšweleditše moento wa monovalent rotavirus ka Aprele 2012 le ge o be o phatlaletše ka nageng, go šoma ga moento go be go le magareng ge go bapetšwa le ka dinageng tše di hlabologilego.
Amharic: ጋና ሞኖቫለንት የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባትን በኤፕሪል 2012 ያስተዋወቀች ሲሆን ምንም እንኳ የክትባቱ ሽፋን ከፍተኛ ቢሆንም ከበለጸጉ ሃገሮች ጋር ሲነጻጸር አፈጻጸሙ መጠነኛ ነው፡፡

English: The predictors of low vaccine effectiveness in LICs are poorly understood, and the drivers of subnational heterogeneity in rotavirus vaccine impact are unknown.
Luganda: Ebiviirako eddagala erigema obutakola bulungi mu LCIs tebimanyiddwa bulungi, n’ebireetera obwawufu mu bitundu by’eggwanga mu kugema rotavirus nabyo tebimanyiddwa.
Yoruba: Òye ohun tí àwọn alásọtẹ́lẹ̀ bí àjẹsára ò ṣe ní ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa sí ní LICs ò yéni tó, àti pé àwọn tí wọ́n ń fa ìyapa ipa tí àjẹsára fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ní apá gúúsù orílẹ̀-èdè ò fojú hàn.
Zulu: Izibikezelo zokusebenza kokugoma okuphansi kuma-LIC aziqondakali kahle, futhi abashayeli be-subnational heterogeneity kumthelela wokugomela i-rotavirus abaziwa.
Hausa: Ba a fahimci masu hasashen ƙarancin tasirin allurar rigakafi a cikin LICs ba, kuma ba a san masu samar da ƙasƙanci daban-daban a cikin tasirin rigakafin cutar zawon yara ba.
Northern Sotho: Dintlhakakanywa tše di bakago kelo ya fase ya go šoma ga moento go di-LIC ga di hwetšagale gabotse, le gona dintlha tše di šušumetšago maitemogelo a go fapafapana ka dikarolong tša naga ka seabe sa moento wa rotavirus ga di tsebje.
Amharic: በዝ.ገ.ሃ ያሉ የክትባት ዝቅተኛ አፈጻጻም ጠቋሚዎችን በሚገባ የተረዳ የለም፣ እንዲሁም በልዩ ልዩ ንኡስ ብሄሮች ውስጥ ያሉት የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት ተጽእኖ አንቀሳቃሾች  ምንነት አልታወቀም፡፡

English: We used mathematical models to investigate variations in rotavirus incidence in children <5 years old in Ghana.
Luganda: Twakozesa emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala okunoonyereza ku njawulo mu bulwadde bwa rotavirus mu baana ab’emyaka <5 egy’obukulu mu Ghana.
Yoruba: A lo módẹ́ẹ̀lì ìṣirò láti tọpinpin àwọn ìyàtọ̀ nínú ìṣẹ̀l̀ẹ̀ fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru nínú àwọn ọmọ <ọdun 5 ní Ghana.
Zulu: Sisebenzise amamodeli ezibalo ukuze siphenye ukuhluka kwezehlakalo ze-rotavirus ezinganeni ezineminyaka engu-5 ubudala eGhana.
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da tsarin lissafi domin bincika bambance-bambance a cikin kamuwa da cutar zawon yara a cikin yara ‘yan ƙasa da shekaru 5 a ƙasar Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše memmotlolo ya mmetse go nyakišiša dipharologantšho go diabe tša rotavirus go bana ba mengwaga ye <5 go la Ghana.
Amharic: በጋና <5 አመት በሚሆናቸው ልጆች ላይ የሮታ ቫይረስ የክስተት መለዋወጥን ለመመርመር የሂሳብ ሞዴሎችን ተጠቅመናል፡፡

English: We fit models to surveillance and case-control data from three different hospitals: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital in Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Kumasi, and War Memorial Hospital in Navrongo.
Luganda: Twateeka emitetenkanyirizo ezo okulondoola n’okugeraageranyizaako obubaka okuva mu malwaliro asatu: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital mu Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital mu Kumasi, ne War Memorial Hospital mu Navrongo.
Yoruba: A fi àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà láti ṣiṣẹ́ ìṣàkíyèsí àyíká àti dátà ajẹmọ́ ìṣàkóso-irúfẹ́ àìsàn láti oríṣiríṣi ilé-ìwòsàn mẹ́ta: Ilé-ìwòsàn ìkọ́ṣẹ́ Korle-Bu ní Accra, Ilé-ìwòsàn ìkọ́ṣẹ́ Komfo Anokye ní Kumasi, àti Ilé-Ìwòsàn Oníìrántí Ogun ní Navrongo.
Zulu: Sifaka amamodeli kudatha yokugada kanye nokulawula amacala avela ezibhedlela ezintathu ezahlukene: Isibhedlela Sokufundisa saseKorle-Bu e-Accra, i-Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital e-Kumasi, kanye ne-War Memorial Hospital e-Navrongo.
Hausa: Mun dace da samfura don sa-ido da bayanan kula da rukunoni-biyu daga asibitoci daban-daban guda uku: Asibitin Koyarwa na Korle-Bu da ke Accra da Asibitin Koyarwa na Komfo Anokye a Kumasi, da kuma Asibitin Tunawa da Yaƙi a Navrongo.
Northern Sotho: Re abela dimmotlolo ka datha ye e hwetšwago go diphatišišo le ya taolo ya malwetši go tšwa dipetleleng tše tharo tša go fapafapana: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital go la Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital go la Kumasi, le War Memorial Hospital go la Navrongo.
Amharic: ሞዴሎችን ከሶስት የተለያዩ ሆስፒታሎች የክትትል እና  የክስተት-መቆጣጠሪያ መረጃዎች ጋር እናስማማለን: በአክራ ኮርሌ-ቡ የማስተማሪያ ሆስፒታል ፣በኩማሲ ኮምፎ አንኮዬ የማስተማሪያ ሆስፒታል እና በናቭሮንጎ የጦርነት መታሰቢያ ሆስፒታል፡፡

English: The models were fitted to both pre- and post-vaccine data to estimate parameters describing the transmission rate, waning of maternal immunity, and vaccine response rate.
Luganda: Emitetenkanyirizo gyateekebwa ku bubaka bwa mirundi ebiri, okugema nga tekunnaba ne nga nga kuwedde okuteebereza ebireetera okunnyonnyola ekigero ky’okusaasaana, okukendeera kw’obusibage bwa bamaama, n’ekigero ky’okujjumbira okugema.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì yìí sínú data tí ó dá lé kí wọ́n tó gba àti lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n gba àjẹsára náà láti ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n fún bí ó tí ń ràn, bí ó tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ tako àjẹsára ìyá àti ọmọ inú, àti bí àjẹsára náà tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ sí.
Zulu: Amamodeli afakwe kukho kokubili idatha yangaphambi nangemuva kokugoma ukuze kulinganiswe imingcele echaza izinga lokutheleleka, ukuncipha kokuvikeleka komama, kanye nezinga lokusabela komgomo.
Hausa: An haɗa samfuran zuwa bayanan kafin rigakafi da kuma bayan allurar domin ƙididdige sigogin da suke kwatanta adadin watsawa, raguwar rigakafi na uwa da adadin amsar allurar rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Memmotlolo e be e abetšwe ka datha ya pele ga tlhabelo ya moento le ya morago ga tlhabelo go akanya mellwane ye e hlalošago kelo ya phetetšo, go fokola ga phetišetšo ya mašole a mmele a bomma go maseana a ka mpeng, le kelo ya go ikarabela ga moento.

English: The seasonal pattern and age distribution of rotavirus cases varied among the three study sites in Ghana.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu Enkyukakyuka mu kiseera ne mu myaka gy’obukulu mu balwadde ba rotavirus byakyukakyuka mu bifo ebisatu ebyanoonyerezebwako mu Ghana.
Yoruba: Bí fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ṣe ń wáyé lọ́dọ́ọdún àti bí ó ṣe ń mú àwọn ọjọ́ orí kànkan yàtọ̀ láàárín àwọn ibi ìwádìí mẹ́tẹ́èta ní Ghana.
Zulu: Iphethini yesizini kanye nokusatshalaliswa kweminyaka kwamacala e-rotavirus kwahlukahluka phakathi kwezindawo ezintathu zocwaningo eGhana.
Hausa: Tsarin yanayi da rarraba shekarun cututtukan zawon yara sun bambanta tsakanin wuraren bincike guda uku a ƙasar Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Seemo sa go fetogafetoga le kakaretšo ya mengwaga go mathata a go amantšhwa le rotavirus di be di fapana magareng ga mafelo a mararo a dinyakišišo nageng ya Ghana.
Amharic: የሮታ ቫይረስ ገጠመኞች፣ ወቅታዊ ዘይቤ እና የእድሜ ክፍፍል በሶስቱ የጋና የጥናት ጣቢያዎች የተለያዩ ነበሩ፡፡

English: Our model was able to capture the spatio-temporal variations in rotavirus incidence across the three sites and showed good agreement with the age distribution of observed cases.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwaffe gwasobola okukenga enneekalirizakiseera mu bulwadde bwa rotavirus mu bifo ebisatu ebinoonyerezebwako era ne biraga okukkaanya okulungi n’emyaka gy’obukulu mu balwadde abatunuulirwa.
Yoruba: Módẹ́èlì wa ṣiṣẹ́ gbígba àwọn ìyátọ̀ tí ó wà nínú àwọn ìwàláàyè ìṣèlẹ̀ fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ní àwọn ibi mẹ́tẹ́ẹ̀ta nígbà kan náà àti ṣàfihàn ohun kan náà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí nípa ìgbéléwọ̀n ti ọjọ́ orí.
Zulu: Imodeli yethu ikwazile ukuthwebula ukuhluka kwe-spatio-temporal kwezehlakalo ze-rotavirus kuzo zonke iziza ezintathu futhi yabonisa ukuvumelana okuhle nokusatshalaliswa kweminyaka kwamacala abhekiwe.
Hausa: Samfurinmu ya sami damar ɗaukar bambance-bambancen lokaci-lokaci a cikin abin da ya faru na cutar zawon yara a cikin wurare uku kuma ya nuna kyakkyawar yarjejeniya tare da rarraba shekarun da aka lura.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo wa rena o be o kgona go lemoga dipharologantšho tša sekgoba le nako go dikelo tša rotavirus go akaretša mafelo a mararo a dinyakišišo le go bontšha tumelelano ye botse ka kakaretšo ya mengwaga go malwetši ao a lemogilwego.
Amharic: ሞዴላችን በሶስቱ ጣቢያዎች የሮታ ቫይረስን የቦታ-ጊዜ ገጠመኝ ልዩነቶች ማግኘት የቻለ ሲሆን ከተስተዋሉት ገጠመኞች የእድሜ ስርጭት ጋርም ጥሩ ስምምነትን አሳይቷል፡፡

English: The rotavirus transmission rate was highest in Accra and lowest in Navrongo, while the estimated duration of maternal immunity was longer (~5 months) in Accra and Kumasi and shorter (~3 months) in Navrongo.
Luganda: Ekigero ky’okusaasaana kwa rotavirus kyali waggulu mu Accra ate ne kiba wansi ddala mu Navrongo, so ate okuteebereza kw’obusibage bwa bamaama bwali waggulu (emyezi ~5) mu Accra ne Kumasi ne buba wansi (emyezi ~3) mu Navrongo.
Yoruba: Bí fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ṣe ń ràn pọ̀ ní Accra tí ó sì jẹ́ díẹ̀ ní Navrongo, tí ó jẹ́ pé ìṣirò àkókò ti àjẹsára ìyá àti ọmọ inú sì gùn (~oṣù 5) ní Accra àti Kumasi ti ó sì kéré ní (~oṣù 3) ní Navrongo.
Zulu: Izinga lokudluliswa kwe-rotavirus laliphezulu kakhulu e-Accra futhi liphansi kakhulu e-Navrongo, kuyilapho isikhathi esilinganiselwe sokuvikeleka komama sasinde (~ izinyanga ezingu-5) e-Accra nase-Kumasi futhi sibe sifushane (~ izinyanga ezingu-3) e-Navrongo.

Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlose ukuthola ukuthi yini edale ukuthi umuthi wokugomela i-rotavirus ungasebenzi kahle eGhana, njengesibonelo sezwe elineholo eliphansi.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi nuni da kuma gano abin da ya sa allurar rigakafin cutar zawon yara ba ta da tasiri sosai a ƙasar Ghana, a matsayin misali na ƙasa mai ƙaramin ƙarfi.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di nepile go utolla gore ke eng seo se bakilego gore moento wa rotavirus o se šome gabotse nageng ya Ghana, bjalo ka mohlala wa naga yeo e hwetšago letseno la fase.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ካላቸው ሃገሮች ጋናን እንደ ምሳሌ በመውሰድ የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት እጅግ አነስተኛ ውጤት እንዲኖረው የሆነበትን ምክንያት ለማግኘት ያለመ ነው፡፡

English: They wanted to find the factors that can be dealt with so that governments can formulate strategies to improve the performance of the rotavirus vaccine in Ghana.
Luganda: Baayagala okuzuula ensonga ezisobola okukolebwako gavumenti esobole okufuna obukodyo bw’okutumbula ku nkola y’eddagala erigema rotavirus mu Ghana.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ wá àwọn ohun tí wọ́n lè mójú tó kí àwọn ìjọba lè wá àwọn ọ̀nà tí ó máa mú ìtẹ̀síwájú bá iṣẹ́ àjẹsára fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ní Ghana.
Zulu: Babefuna ukuthola izici ezingase zibhekane nazo ukuze ohulumeni bakwazi ukwenza amasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza komgomo we-rotavirus eGhana.
Hausa: Sun so nemo abubuwan da za a iya magance su domin gwamnatoci su tsara dabarun inganta aikin rigakafin cutar zawon yara a ƙasar Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go hwetša dintlha tšeo go ka šoganwago le tšona gore mebušo e kgone go hlama maanophethagatšo go kaonafatša go šoma ga moento wa rotavirus nageng ya Ghana.
Amharic: መንግስታት በጋና የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት አፈጻጸም እንዲሻሻል እቅዶችን መንደፍ ይችሉ ዘንድ መስተካከል የሚገባቸውን ምክንያቶች ለማግኘት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡ ተመራማሪዎቹ ሮታ ቫይረስን የተመለከቱ የገጠመኝ እና የሞት መረጃዎችን ከሶስት ሆስፒታሎች ሰብስበዋል፡፡

English: The researchers gathered data regarding rotavirus cases and deaths from three hospitals in Ghana: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital in Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Kumasi, and War Memorial Hospital in Navrongo.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku bulwadde bwa rotavirus n’okufa okuva mu malwaliro asatu mu Gahana: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital mu Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital mu Kumasi, ne War Memorial Hospital mu Navrongo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàkójọpọ̀ àwọn dátà tó jẹ mọ́ àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ fáírọ́ọ̀sì tí ń fa ìgbẹ́ gbuuru àti ikú tí wọ́n ti fà ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn mẹ́ta ní Ghana: Ilé-ìwòsàn ìkọ́ṣẹ́ Korle-Bu ní Accra, Ilé-ìwòsàn ìkọ́ṣẹ́ Komfo Anokye ní Kumasi, àti Ilé-Ìwòsàn Oníìrántí Ogun ní Navrongo.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqa imininingwane mayelana namacala e-rotavirus nokufa kwabantu ezibhedlela ezintathu eGhana: Isibhedlela Sokufundisa saseKorle-Bu e-Accra, i-Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital e-Kumasi, kanye ne-War Memorial Hospital e-Navrongo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattara bayanai game da cututtukan zawon yara da mace-mace daga asibitoci uku a ƙasar Ghana: Asibitin Koyarwa na Korle-Bu da ke Accra da Asibitin Koyarwa na Komfo Anokye a Kumasi, da kuma Asibitin Tunawa da Yaƙi a Navrongo.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgobokeditše datha malebana le malwetši le mahu a go bakwa ke rotavirus go tšwa dipetleleng tše tharo tša Ghana: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital go la Accra, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital go la Kumasi, le War Memorial Hospital go la Navrongo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሮታ ቫይረስን የተመለከቱ የገጠመኝ እና የሞት መረጃዎችን ከሶስት ሆስፒታሎች ሰብስበዋል: በአክራ ኮርሌ-ቡ የማስተማሪያ ሆስፒታል ፣በኩማሲ ኮምፎ አንኮዬ የማስተማሪያ ሆስፒታል እና በናቭሮንጎ የጦርነት መታሰቢያ ሆስፒታል፡፡

English: They then used mathematical models to compare what happened before and after the rotavirus vaccine was introduced, and investigated the factors that might have contributed to the low vaccine effectiveness.
Luganda: Olwo ate ne bakozesa emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala okugeraageranya ebyasooka okubaawo mu kusooka ate n’oluvannyuma lw’okutandika okukozesa eddagala erigema rotavirus, era ne banoonyereza ensonga eziyinza okuba nga ze zaaleetera eddagala erigema obutakola bulungi.
Yoruba: Nígbà náà ni wọ́n lò àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì ìṣirò láti ṣe àfiwéra ohun tí ó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ kí wọ́n tó àti lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí wọ́n ṣàfihàn àjẹsára fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru, tí wọ́n sì tún ṣe ìtọpinpin àwọn ohun tí ó lè mú ìfàsẹ́yìn bá iṣẹ́ àjẹsára lára.
Zulu: Babe sebesebenzisa amamodeli ezibalo ukuze baqhathanise okwenzeka ngaphambi nangemva kokwethulwa komgomo we-rotavirus, futhi baphenya izici okungenzeka zibe nomthelela ekusebenzeni okuphansi komgomo.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi amfani da tsarin lissafi don kwatanta abin da ya faru kafin da kuma bayan da aka gabatar da maganin rigakafin cutar zawon yara, kuma sun binciki abubuwan da suke iya haifar da rashin ingancin rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka ba šomišitše dimmotlolo tša mmetse go bapetša seo se hlagilego pele ga ge go tšweletšwa moento wa rotavirus le ka morago ga tšweletšo, ba be ba nyakišiša dintlha tšeo di ka bago di bakile go šoma ga maemo a fase ga moento.
Amharic: ከዚያም ሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት ከመተዋወቁ በፊት እና በኋላ የተከሰተውን ነገር ለማነጻጸር የሂሳብ ሞዴሎችን የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን የክትባቱ ውጤት ዝቅተኛነት ላይ  አስተዋጽኦ ሊኖራቸው የሚችሉ ምክንያቶችን መርምረዋል፡፡

English: The study showed that Accra had the highest rate of rotavirus infections, while the Navrongo region had the lowest rotavirus transmission rates.
Luganda: Okunooneyereza kwalaga nti Accra yalina abalwadde ba rotavirus abasinga obungi, so ng’ate ekitundu kya Navrongo kyalina okusaasaana kwa rotavirus okusinga obutono.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí fi hàn pé Accra ni àwọn èèyàn púpọ̀ tí wọ́n ní àìsàn fáírọ́ọ̀sì tí ń fa ìgbẹ́ gbuuru, tí àgbègbè Navrongo sì níwọ̀n lórí bí ó ṣé ń ràn sí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi i-Accra inezinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokutheleleka nge-rotavirus, kuyilapho isifunda sase-Navrongo sasinezinga eliphansi kakhulu lokudlulisela i-rotavirus.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna cewa Accra ita ce ta fi kowacce yawan kamuwa da cutar zawon yara, yayin da yankin Navrongo yake da mafi ƙarancin yawan yaɗuwar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di laeditše gore Accra e bile le kelo ya godimodimo ya diphetetšo tša rotavirus, mola selete sa Navrongo se bile le dikelo tša fasefase tša phetetšo ya rotavirus.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንዳሳየው የናቭሮንጎ አውራጃ ዝቅተኛ የሮታ ቫይረስ ስርጭት ምጥነት ሲኖረው በአክራ ያለው የሮታ ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን ምጥነት ደግሞ ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡

English: The researchers suspected that the immunity children get from their breastfeeding mothers against rotavirus might interfere with the vaccine; they found that maternal immunity was five (5) months in Accra, while it was a shorter three (3) months in Navrongo.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateebereza nti obusibage abaana bwe baggya ku bannyaabwe nga bayonka okubataasa rotavirus buyinza okutaataaganya eddagala erigema; baakizuula nti obusibage bwa bamaama bwali ku myezi etaanu (5) mu Accra, ate ne buba nga tebuweza myezi esatu (3) mu Navrongo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàkíyèsí pé àjẹsára tí àwọn ọmọdé ń gbà láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìyá tí ó ń fún wọn lọ́mú tí ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ tako fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru lè ṣiṣẹ́ tako abẹrẹ́ àjẹsára náà; wọ́n ri pé àjẹsára ìyá àti ọmọ inú jẹ́ fún oṣù (5) márùn-ún ní Accra, nígbà tí àsìkò náà kúrú tí ó jẹ́ oṣù (3) mẹ́ta ní Navrongo.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basola ukuthi ukuzivikela kwezingane ezikuthola komama bazo abancelisa ibele ngokumelene ne-rotavirus kungase kuphazamise umgomo; bathole ukuthi ukuzivikela komama kwakuyizinyanga ezinhlanu (5) e-Accra, kanti kwaba mfushane izinyanga ezintathu (3) eNavrongo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi zargin cewa rigakafin da yara suke samu daga iyayensu mata masu shayarwa daga cutar zawon yara yana iya yin katsalandan ga rigakafin; sun kuma gano cewa rigakafin iyaye mata ya kai watanni biyar (5) a Accra, yayin da aka rage watanni uku (3) a Navrongo.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba belaela gore mašole a mmele ao bana ba a hwetšago go batswadi bao ba ba nyantšhago letswele kgahlanong le rotavirus a ka ba a šitiša moento go šoma; ba hweditše gore phetišetšo ya mašole a mmele a bomma go maseana a ka mpeng e bile dikgwedi tše hlano (5) go la Accra, mola go la Navrongo e bile fela dikgwedi tše tharo (3).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ህጻናት ጡት ከሚያጠቡ እናቶቻቸው የሚያገኙት መድህን በሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት ላይ ጣልቃ ሳይገባ እንዳልቀረ ጠርጥረዋል: የእናቶች መድህን በናቭሮንጎ ለ3 አጭር ወራት ሲሆን በአክራ ለ5 ወራት ነበር።

English: They found that the vaccine was most effective in Accra and Kumasi, and least effective in Navrongo.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti eddagala erigema lyali lisinga kukola bulungi mu Accra ne Kumasi, ate ne litakola bulungi mu Navrongo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé àjẹsára náà ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa ní Accra àti Kumasi, tí kò sì ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa ní Navrongo.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi umgomo wawusebenza kakhulu e-Accra nase-Kumasi, futhi usebenza kancane e-Navrongo.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa maganin ya fi tasiri a Accra da kuma Kumasi, kuma ba shi da tasiri a Navrongo.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore moento o be o šoma gabotse go la Accra le Kumasi, gomme o sa šome gabotse go la Navrongo.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት በአክራ እና በኩማሲ በበለጠ ሁኔታ ውጤታማ ሲሆን በናቭሮንጎ ውጤታማነቱ አነስተኛ ነበር፡፡

English: While similar studies have used mathematical models to evaluate the effects of vaccines on rotavirus in low income countries, they considered how rotavirus is transmitted and spread within a country.
Luganda: Wadde ng’okunoonyereza okufaananako bwe kuti kukozesezza emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala okwekaliriza ebiva mu kukozesa eddagala erigema ku rotavirus mu mawanga agakyakula, baatunuulira engeri rotavirus gy’esaasaanamu n’okusaasaanyizibwa mu ggwanga erimu.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó jọ èyí ti ṣàmúlò àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì oníṣirò láti ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n ipa àjẹsára náà lórí fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí wọn ò pawó púpọ̀, wọ́n wo bí wọ́n ṣe ń kó fáírọ́ọ̀sì tí ń fa ìgbẹ́ gbuuru àti bí ó ṣe ń ràn láàárín orílẹ̀-èdè kan.
Zulu: Nakuba ucwaningo olufanayo lusebenzise amamodeli ezibalo ukuhlola imiphumela yemithi yokugoma ku-rotavirus emazweni anengeniso ephansi, bacabangele ukuthi i-rotavirus isakazwa futhi isabalale kanjani ezweni.
Hausa: Duk da yake irin wannan binciken sun yi amfani da tsarin lissafi domin kimanta tasirin rigakafin cutar zaɓon yara a cikin ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfi, sun yi la’akari da yadda cutar zawon yara take yaɗuwa da kuma bazuwa a cikin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge dinyakišišo tše di swanago di šomišitše dimmotlolo tša mmetse go lekola diabe tša meento go rotavirus ka dinageng tše di hwetšago letseno la fase, ba lekodišišitše ka moo rotavirus e fetetšwago le go phatlalatšwa ka gona ka nageng.
Amharic: ተመሳሳይ ጥናቶች ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው ሃገሮች ውስጥ ክትባቱ በሮታ ቫይረስ ላይ ያመጣቸውን ውጤቶች ለመገምገም የሂሳብ ሞዴሎችን ሲጠቀሙ ሮታ ቫይረስ በሃገር ውስጥ እንዴት እንደሚተላለፍ እና እንደሚሰራጭ ከግምት ውስጥ አስገብተው ነበር፡፡

English: These other studies have found that the rotavirus vaccine’s effectiveness can be greatly weakened when patients do not receive the complete vaccine shots in a schedule of multiple doses.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno okulala kwalaga nti eddagala okukola obulungi okw’eddagala erigema rotavirus kusobola okunafuwazibwa ennyo abalwadde bwe batafuna ddagala ligema mu bujjuvu mu nteekateeka ya doozi ez’enajwulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwádìí míràn yìí fi hàn pé ìfàsẹ́yìn lè bá iṣẹ́ àjẹsára fáírọ́ọ̀sì alákòóràn onígbẹ̀ẹ́ gbuuru tí àwọn aláìsàn náà ò bá gba gbogbo abẹ́ré àjẹsara náà bó ti yẹ.
Zulu: Lolu olunye ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukusebenza komgomo we-rotavirus kungaba buthaka kakhulu uma iziguli zingakutholi ukushoshwa okuphelele kokugoma ohlelweni lwemithamo eminingi.
Hausa: Waɗannan sauran binciken sun gano cewa tasirin rigakafin zawon yara zai iya raunana sosai lokacin da marasa lafiya ba su sami cikakkiyar allurar rigakafi ba a cikin jadawalin adadin allurai da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše tše dingwe di utollotše gore go šoma gabotse ga moento wa rotavirus go ka fokotšwa maatla ge balwetši ba sa hlabelwe ditšhwaana ka moka tša moento go ya ka lenaneokabo la dilekanyo.
Amharic: እነዚህ ሌሎች ጥናቶች የሮታ ቫይረስ ክትባት ውጤታማነት በእጅጉ ሊዳከም የሚችለው ታካሚዎች በተከፋፈለ መጠን በመርሃ ግብር የሚሰጠውን ሙሉ ክትባት በማይወስዱበት ጊዜ እንደሆነ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: The researchers have added to this body of knowledge by considering the duration of maternal immunity for specific regions within Ghana.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bongedde ku kumanya okuliwo nga batunuulira ebbanga obusibage bwa bamaama lye bumala mu bitundu ebimu mu Ghana.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàfikún sí ìmọ̀ yìí nípa ṣíse àgbéyẹ̀wò àjẹsára ìyá àti ọmọ inú ní fún àwọn àgbègbè kan ní Ghana.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bengeze kulo mkhakha wolwazi ngokucabangela ubude besikhathi sokuvikeleka komama ezifundeni ezithile ngaphakathi kweGhana.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ƙara wa wannan ilimin ta hanyar la'akari da tsawon lokacin rigakafi na mahaifiya ga takamaiman yankuna a cikin ƙasar Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tlaleleditše go sešego se sa tsebo ka go lekodišiša nako ya phetišetšo ya mašole a mmele a bomma go maseana a ka mpeng ka dileteng tša go ikgetha ka nageng ya Ghana.
